name: Vreden (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Vreden (two saints above a black cross on yellow and blue).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident in Münster of 14 September 1973 the city was granted the right to bear arms, a flag and an official seal; the banner is striped lengthwise in two equal stripes of blue and yellow with the arms in the middle.

features.role: Vreden arms — two saints above a cross
